description: This PHP script functions as a command-line utility to evaluate JMESPath expressions on JSON input or test cases. It supports running compliance tests by loading test definitions from external files and executing specified expressions, providing input data either through STDIN or script parameters.

classes.name: DebugRuntime
classes.description: A class providing debugging capabilities for JMESPath expression execution.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the DebugRuntime instance to execute a JMESPath expression on provided data.
